stem:
Tanya washes rice in a tall glass of water. She leaves the cloudy water undisturbed. Fine sand settles at the bottom. She then carefully pours off the clearer water.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Settling of the sand at the bottom is sedimentation.
Pouring off the clearer water is decantation.
Settling of the sand at the bottom is decantation.

teacher.key_rationale: Heavier insoluble sand settling is sedimentation; pouring off the clearer liquid is decantation. Settling is not decantation.
